atlases.name: coffee
atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Production transparent sprite atlas for a cozy cafe game.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 is the approved cafe scene; image 2 approved furniture sprites. Match their softly rounded shapes, rich amber and cream highlights, chestnut-brown outlines, warm autumn palette, hand painted pixel clusters, charming polished pixel-art. The image is an atlas of isolated small food object sprites, NOT a scene. Each sprite uses a consistent elevated three-quarter view with visible top surface and front. Coarse crisp pixel edges, clear readable silhouettes, restrained detail, no smooth vector outlines, no realism. Truly transparent background and transparent gaps; never a checkerboard drawing. All items centered fully inside their cells with at least 18% transparent padding on every side. No ground, no cast ground shadows, no additional props, labels, numbers, gridlines, text, logos, frames or watermarks. Every requested cell is separate, nothing overlaps or touches another cell.
Generate a square 1024x1024 image containing exactly 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, each cell 256x256. Fourteen coffee sprites, row-major order:
Row 1: espresso: tiny ivory demitasse with dark coffee and crema on matching saucer; americano: taller terracotta ceramic mug filled with black coffee; latte: broad ivory cup with a clear milk-foam heart; cappuccino: peach cup with abundant white foam and cinnamon dust.
Row 2: flatwhite: low sage cup with a fine flat rosetta foam surface; cortado: small clear short glass of equally layered espresso and warm milk; mocha: cocoa-brown ceramic cup with cream swirl and chocolate drizzle; vienna: tall clear footed cup of black coffee crowned by whipped cream.
Row 3: macchiato: tiny caramel-colored espresso cup with single dollop of milk foam; coldbrew: squat clear tumbler of dark amber coffee and ice cubes; dirty: short glass with white cold milk bottom and dark espresso top; pourover: amber glass server/carafe of brewed coffee, wooden collar.
Row 4: creamcoffee: beige coffee glass with thick smooth cream cap; affogato: small cream dessert bowl with vanilla ice cream and espresso drizzle; cell 3 empty transparent; cell 4 empty transparent.
Make each identity visibly distinct. Cups and saucers count as one sprite.

Generate a square image containing exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, every cell equal-sized. Twelve cozy cafe pantry ingredient sprites, row-major order:
Row 1: coffee beans: small open tan cloth sack filled with glossy roasted coffee beans, with 2 beans at its base; milk: short rounded cream glass milk bottle filled with milk and a red gingham fabric cap; flour: small warm ivory paper flour sack, folded top and simple wheat-ear pictogram without words; butter: golden rectangular butter block with one cut pat on folded cream paper.
Row 2: eggs: three plump ivory and warm beige eggs gathered in a small low woven nest; sugar: petite cream bowl with piled white sugar cubes; tea: small sage cylindrical tin, lid slightly tilted, visible brown loose tea leaves and tiny leaf pictogram; spices: a squat terracotta jar with warm ground cinnamon plus two short cinnamon sticks resting against it.
Row 3: cocoa: small cocoa-brown tin with a neat mound of cocoa powder and tiny cacao-bean pictogram; cream: petite round ivory ceramic pitcher filled with thick cream, one little spout and handle; fruit: one compact cluster of red strawberry, orange slice, red apple, and two blueberries; matcha: small warm wood bowl with bright green matcha powder and a tiny bamboo scoop.
All containers short and plump, not tall, and all distinct. No written text. Sprite object grouping must remain compact. Preserve 18% transparent padding in every cell. All objects fully visible and independent.
CRITICAL production revision: Make every object dramatically SMALLER within its cell. Each sprite must fit completely within the CENTRAL HALF of its cell, with 25% truly empty transparent margin on all four sides. This means each sprite occupies at most 12.5% of total image width and at most 16% of total image height. Nothing reaches the outer image edge. No objects touch. Thin dark warm-brown contour only; no red fringe, no glow, no colored edge halo, no scattered dust/noise. One compact single object grouping per cell. The flour and butter have a very large transparent gap, as do cream and fruit. The fruit's leaves must remain inside its own cell.
